policy.note: Any generated PNG is a candidate only. It is not final art and must not be wired into production until human visual review passes.

jobs.title: Produce Knight t01 longsword walk + slash candidate sheets
jobs.prompt: ASTRAYA Knight tier-1 longsword weapon layers only (no body). Deliver two separate transparent PNG LPC sheets: (1) walkcycle 576x256 = 9 columns x 4 rows of 64x64 cells; (2) slash 384x256 = 6 columns x 4 rows of 64x64 cells. Row order must be up, left, down, right with no mirroring. Match existing LPC feet line and per-frame sword-grip/hand alignment. Candidate-only; not final until human visual review.

current_stand_in.note: knight_sword_t01 currently uses a temporary dagger for slash and has no walk sword sheet.

gates.detail: Do not rewire js/data/characterVisuals.js knight_sword_t01 away from the temporary dagger until both walk and slash candidate sheets pass human visual review.
